Class SymbolTable

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.SymbolTable
public class SymbolTable extends Object

Maps arbitrary strings to compact int identifiers (symbol IDs) and back. Interning a string that has already been registered returns the same ID in O(1) average time (one HashMap lookup). This mirrors the SymbolId type in the Rust sigma-rs project, where all KB terms are stored as u64 symbols to enable O(1) equality and cheap array indexing.

Usage

   SymbolTable syms = new SymbolTable();
   int dogId  = syms.intern("Dog");       // 0
   int catId  = syms.intern("Cat");       // 1
   int dog2   = syms.intern("Dog");       // 0  — same ID
   String name = syms.getName(dogId);     // "Dog"

Thread safety

Not thread-safe. Populate from a single thread (e.g. during buildCaches()) then treat as read-only for concurrent accessors.

Integration with KBcache

KBcache creates one SymbolTable instance and uses it to build int-indexed parent/child adjacency maps via KBcache.buildSymbolTaxonomy(). The symbol-indexed accessors (KBcache.getParentsSymbol(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), KBcache.getChildrenSymbol(java.lang.String, java.lang.String)) avoid repeated String hashing during hot query paths.

    • intern

      public int intern(String name)
      Returns the integer ID for name, assigning a new ID if this is the first time name has been seen.

      IDs are assigned sequentially starting at 0.

      Parameters:
      name - the string to intern (must not be null)
      Returns:
      the stable integer ID for name

    • lookup

      public int lookup(String name)
      Returns the ID for name if it has already been interned, or -1 if it is unknown. Does NOT register the string.
      Parameters:
      name - the string to look up
      Returns:
      the ID, or -1 if not interned
